title: 08 · Music player · Calamondin Tapes
strengths: Two real ideas: section markers on the waveform ('1:42 the drop', 'bridge', 'outro') and a record sliding out from behind the sleeve
Believable label data: 'CLMD-014 / SIDE A / TRACK 3 OF 9', 'Heat Lamp Lullabies · 2026 · on cassette', 'Buy $1', queue rows with durations, a mini player that buffers 'on a slow connection'
Controls are complete: six play states, four scrubber states, toggles off/on with the accent only when on, an error with Retry
slop_signals: The generated cover is a pink-orange-violet gradient with a spiral and a dotted halftone corner: the stock 'AI album art' blob, and it then paints the whole hero card magenta-to-violet with a glow bleeding onto the page
Dark + neon pink: the 'Saved' pill, the toggles, the queue's 'now' row and the error are all hot pink on near-black
Four surface treatments in one card (gradient fill, translucent white chips, a solid white disc, a pink pill) stacked with a 24 px outer and 16 px inner radius
Title 'Sodium Summer' in Unbounded 850 beside 'Juniper Static' with a verified badge: the badge is a borrowed Spotify device, not a cassette label's
fixes: Replace the cover with flat two-colour sleeve art (a riso-style print: one ink, one paper, hard shapes), and sample only one flat tint from it for the card, as TIDAL does
Remove the page glow; keep the card a single flat dark tint with the art as the one vivid object
Use one chip style (translucent white) for Saved, Buy and volume, and reserve pink for the played waveform
Drop the verified badge; put the label name where it was

references.what: The waveform is the scrubber with the played part in orange and the rest grey; cover art is designed, not a gradient
The page is one flat colour tinted from the art and the art is the only vivid object; controls live in a plain bottom bar
Full-bleed dark art with white controls and a thin progress line; no glow anywhere
Gradient-blob covers like ours; shows the register the piece currently sits in and why it reads as generated

owner.said: Hide until it passes at 4 (won the blind test, the reviewer stayed at 3)
